note: Mask Off's deck: question cards asked across the room, answered out loud (never typed, sent or stored). Ids are permanent: never renumber or reuse one. Levels: 1 light, 2 real, 3 deep; the host picks which are in the deck.

cards.text: What's something that always makes you feel like a kid again?
What's a small thing that instantly makes your day better?
What's a song that takes you back to a specific moment?
What did you want to be when you grew up, and why?
What's a compliment you still remember?
What's a place that feels like home that isn't your home?
What are you looking forward to right now?
What's something you're secretly proud of?
What's a habit you picked up from someone you love?
What's the best advice you've ever ignored?
What are you into right now that you'd never post about?
What did your childhood room look like?
What was your first impression of me?
What do you think I'm like when nobody's watching?
What do you think I was like as a kid?
What's a smell that instantly brings back a memory?
What's something you changed your mind about recently?
What's the last thing that made you laugh until it hurt?
What's a small thing someone did for you that you never forgot?
What would your perfect ordinary day look like?
What's a hobby you dropped that you miss?
What's something you're weirdly good at?
Given the choice of anyone in the world, whom would you want as a dinner guest?
Would you like to be famous? In what way?
Before making a telephone call, do you ever rehearse what you are going to say? Why?
What would constitute a “perfect” day for you?
When did you last sing to yourself? To someone else?
Do you have a secret hunch about how you will die?
If you could change anything about the way you were raised, what would it be?
If you could wake up tomorrow having gained any one quality or ability, what would it be?
What's your biggest insecurity?
What's something you wish people asked you about more?
What part of you took the longest to accept?
What's a moment you felt truly seen by someone?
What's something you've been avoiding thinking about?
When do you feel most like yourself?
What's a friendship you lost, and do you miss it?
What's something you pretend not to care about?
What's the hardest goodbye you've had?
What's a fear you've never said out loud?
What do you think people get wrong about you?
What's the bravest thing you've ever done?
What's something you're still healing from?
What do you wish you could tell your younger self?
What do you think my biggest insecurity is?
What's something you think I need to hear right now?
What's a lesson you had to learn more than once?
When did you last feel really proud of yourself?
What's a part of your personality you got from your parents?
What's something you want but feel guilty for wanting?
What's the most "you" thing about you?
Who taught you the most about love, and how?
What do you do when nobody's there to comfort you?
What's something you've stopped telling people because they don't get it?
If a crystal ball could tell you the truth about yourself, your life, the future, or anything else, what would you want to know?
Is there something that you’ve dreamed of doing for a long time? Why haven’t you done it?
What is the greatest accomplishment of your life?
What do you value most in a friendship?
What is your most terrible memory?
What's the most pain you've felt that wasn't physical?
What kind of person was your father?
What kind of person was your mother?
What's something you've never forgiven yourself for?
When was the last time you cried, and why?
What's the loneliest you've ever felt?
What do you need right now that you haven't asked for?
Who do you miss that you never talk about?
What's a version of your life you think about sometimes?
What's something you hope you never become?
What does love mean to you, honestly?
What would you want people to say about you when you're gone?
What's a question you're scared someone will ask you?
What's something you've never told anyone in your family?
What's something you wish your parents understood about you?
What's a moment that changed who you are?
What are you most afraid of losing?
What's the hardest thing you've ever had to forgive?
When did you realize you were becoming an adult?
What's something you're still waiting for someone to apologize for?
What do you wish you'd said to someone before it was too late?
What does your inner voice say to you on your worst days?
What part of your story do you rarely tell?
What would it take for you to feel truly at peace?
Complete this sentence: “I wish I had someone with whom I could share…”
If you were going to become a close friend with your partner, please share what would be important for them to know.
What do you like about me; be very honest this time, saying things that you might not say to someone you’ve just met.
What is an embarrassing moment in your life.
When did you last cry in front of another person? By yourself?
What, if anything, is too serious to be joked about?
If you were to die this evening with no opportunity to communicate with anyone, what would you most regret not having told someone? Why haven’t you told them yet?
Your house, containing everything you own, catches fire. After saving your loved ones and pets, you have time to safely make a final dash to save any one item. What would it be? Why?
Of all the people in your family, whose death would you find most disturbing? Why?
Share a personal problem and ask your partner’s advice on how they might handle it. Also, ask your partner to reflect back to you how you seem to be feeling about the problem you have chosen.
